expansionSections.heading: Microsuction And Safe Ear Wax Removal

deepDiveBlocks.heading: When Professional Removal Is Needed
paragraphs: Cerumen impaction can cause hearing reduction, discomfort and hearing aid problems. Professional microsuction or irrigation is safer than home removal with cotton buds or objects.
Examination comes first — referral is recommended if infection, perforation or sudden hearing loss suggests pathology beyond simple wax blockage.

preparationGuide: Use olive oil drops if advised before appointment
Bring hearing aid if wax affects fit
comparisonPoints: Not suitable if active ear infection suspected
GP referral if perforation or pain with discharge
